name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.8.1 Premiere Pro Timeline & Bin Insertion Fix!
• Fixed Premiere Pro icon import: now reliably imports into 'Icons' bin and places on active timeline track at playhead
• Bulletproof item detection avoiding Premiere sub-bin import bugs
• Error reporting fixes: no more false success messages when host script fails
• Update modal popup works smoothly both automatically and via Check for Updates button
